L6·N7732unmasked layer
Fires on nouns/pronouns used as ordinary referential mentions — e.g. "your **Lord**/**angels**", "your kitties", a name followed by "**is**" — and is strongly *suppressed* by the same words in vocative direct address ("Dear Lord,", "O mind,", "My Lord,"), so it essentially signals "referential, not being addressed."
